summary: Suzano S.A. filed a Form 6-K attaching minutes of a board of directors meeting on April 29, 2026. The agenda included routine appointments to the Statutory Audit Committee and non-statutory committees, and the election of executive vice presidencies. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, or restructuring is mentioned. The filing is a standard report of a foreign private issuer covering ordinary governance matters, not a special situation.
